events.title: Linus Torvalds announces Linux
events.summary: Linus Torvalds posted to comp.os.minix on August 25, 1991 announcing a free operating system [kernel] — the birth of Linux.
events.about: Linux started as a hobby [kernel] for 386 PCs and grew into the [OS] behind Android, cloud servers, and supercomputers. Torvalds' open development model on Usenet and later Git became the template for community-driven systems software.

narrative.whyChosen: Linux is the most widely deployed operating system [kernel] in history.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved open-source [OS] development could outpace proprietary Unix.
narrative.problemSolved: MINIX and commercial Unix were limited for hackers who wanted a freely modifiable [OS].
